sg_shift_top_for_1 = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sg_top_2_id } sg_copy_top_2_to_3 = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sg_top_1_id } sg_copy_top_1_to_2 = yes }
}

sg_shift_top_for_2 = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sg_top_2_id } sg_copy_top_2_to_3 = yes }
}
